themes.description: Users encounter consistent app crashes and bugs upon app installation and usage, disrupting the overall experience.
themes.business_impact: High frequency of app crashes and bugs negatively impact user experience, potentially leading to app uninstalls and revenue loss.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of these issues is likely inadequate testing and quality assurance processes.
themes.action_plan:
• Improve testing and QA processes to identify and fix bugs before deployment
• Increase server capacity to handle user load
• Implement crash reporting and analytics tools to gain insights into failures.

themes.description: Users are consistently dissatisfied with the customer support team citing issues such as delayed responses, rudeness, and lack of helpfulness.
themes.business_impact: Customers may choose to cancel their membership or subscription services due to the unhelpful and inefficient customer support team.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The customer support team may be understaffed, undertrained, or not equipped with the necessary tools to provide timely and effective solutions to customers' issues.
themes.action_plan: • Reassess customer support operations, provide training for support staff on empathetic communication and problem-solving, invest in efficient ticketing and communication tools, and establish clear response time SLAs.

themes.description: Users are complaining about the high brokerage fees charged by the platform. They feel it is too expensive and hinders their potential gains. This has led to a negative experience, particularly for beginner investors.
themes.business_impact: High customer churn and negative word-of-mouth due to the perceived high costs associated with using the platform.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The high brokerage fees may be a result of aggressive pricing, failure to offer competitive fees, or inadequate communication to users about the costs involved.
themes.action_plan: • Review and optimize pricing strategy to ensure a competitive edge, provide clear and concise information about brokerage fees, and offer fee waivers or discounts for heavy users.
